long_biography.plain_text:
Botaş Nehir Tekstil grew from an Istanbul dyeing and finishing plant established in 1986 into a vertically integrated fabric producer. Its production chain now extends from fibre and yarn through knitting, dyeing and printing, with operations in Istanbul, Çerkezköy and Afyon.

Muzaffer Kılavuz chairs that manufacturing platform and has represented it in successive expansion decisions. He hosted university designers at the Çerkezköy plant, signed a new Afyon industrial-land agreement and later backed a school-industry programme covering yarn and knitting technology, internships and graduate recruitment. The school partnership added new laboratories, specialist courses, factory placements and recruitment pathways for technical students.

The active catalogue has no textile or fabric-manufacturing tag. Apparel manufacturing would overstate a business focused on yarn and knitted fabric rather than finished garments, so no active tag is assigned and no one-off dossier candidate is created.

Aydos Yacht's Music reference is used only to resolve the person behind the frozen owner record. Both biographies, all classifications, proposed details and social verification are grounded in the independently documented textile business.
